{{Quote|And there we go. Sorry. It's just business.|Ananah Kragana, after turning on some Republic operatives aboard Mezhra Station|<ref name="DGB">{{WizCite|story=Deal Gone Bad|book=Galaxy of Intrigue}}</ref>}}
'''Ananah Kragana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. However, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic defector [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] [[Mocen Gundross]] persuaded Kragana to enter the service of the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Over a period of several months, Kragana and Gundross worked together to turn valuable commodities and Republic agents over to the Confederacy. At some point during the conflict, a team of Republic operatives were dispatched to investigate Separatist operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], and in her guise as a servant of the Republic, Kragana flew the operatives to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] facility [[Mezhra Station]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Verdant Song]]''. Once they had landed on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], Kragana turned on the operatives and attempted to capture them for the CIS.

==Skills and abilities==
She was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bith (language)/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothese]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Skakoverbal/Legends|Skakoan]].<ref name="GoI" />
